column1: # RAM addresses used by paired code, MoA-US -> PP (tools/xdisc/xdisc.py). votes = paired instructions
# that give this PP address, seen = all paired instructions using the MoA address. module = the code
# that uses it (an address in the module area 0x80050DD8+/0x800490D0+ only holds while that module is
# loaded). Addresses point at the start of what the code names (a table, a record or a field).
